01 — About

Design craft, sped up and scaled by AI.

I'm Karim, a freelance digital marketer and visual designer, working remotely since 2024. I hold Google's Digital Marketing & E-commerce certificate (DGM) and completed Elements of AI through Coursera — a combination that shows up directly in how I work: SEO and keyword research on the marketing side, AI-assisted illustration and even local LLM setups on the technical side, and solid design craft tying it together.

Most of my recent work sits at that intersection — bilingual infographics, social and campaign creatives, and data-led visual explainers for people who need to say something complicated, clearly. I also spent time as an AI Adoption Strategist, helping an organization evaluate and integrate AI tools into everyday workflow — practical experience that feeds back into how I advise clients now. I work directly with clients on Freelancer and over email/WhatsApp, and I'm comfortable owning a project from brief to final file.

Featured project

The Hidden Cost of Technology

A bilingual (English + Bangla) infographic series unpacking how algorithmic platforms and AI systems quietly shape attention, work, and society. I planned the structure, art-directed every panel with AI-assisted illustration, and assembled the data into a clean, dense, screen-readable layout — built to hold up whether someone skims it in five seconds or studies it for five minutes.

RoleConcept, AI-assisted illustration, data visualization, bilingual typesetting
ToolsAI image generation, layout & typography finishing
FormatMulti-panel infographic series, EN + BN
Case study

Woman's Fitness Hub — brand & launch campaign

Full brand and campaign design for a women-only gym in Pirojpur — a logo mark, a QR-enabled membership card, a set of launch posters, a bilingual fitness-tips infographic, and print-ready banners. This one went all the way from design file to real signage: the finished posters are now hanging on the storefront itself.

RoleBrand identity, print & campaign design, bilingual copy (EN/BN)
DeliverablesLogo, member card, 3 posters, infographic, storefront banners
ClientWoman's Fitness Hub — Salma Shopping Mall, Pirojpur
